scope: Isolated product construction validation; not a vendor evaluation or production deployment

base_interpreter.use: read-only base for new private phase interpreters; never install into it

run_root_rule: After approval choose a new absent run ID, reject symlink/ownership collisions, record absolute path and stable candidate. Never reuse a prior run or live store.
test_code_scope: selected package-local suites from the frozen case map
source_install_policy: Export each stable phase candidate to private source without dirty/untracked files. Build candidate wheels privately and check installed origins. Source tests use only that declared private snapshot; do not sync the working environment.

phases.I1-C2: narrow LLM/Memory counter metadata and lock delta
phases.I3-C1: Tools document extra and lock delta before conversion tests
phases.I3-C3: Chat default document edge and lock delta before command adoption
phases.I3-C5: clean final installed profile and Certifi/origin verification

dependency_policy.resolution: Record exact phase lock and artifact URLs/hashes/licenses before install; selected scope only. No unrelated package upgrade. Missing/incompatible intended artifacts stop the affected phase.
dependency_policy.validation_tools: Use existing locked pytest/asyncio, Ruff, mypy and declared test dependencies in private environments. Do not add an undeclared helper tool or inherit prior harness tool activation.

local_binding_policy: Use strict schemas from reviewed shared-contracts. Generate disposable test route/capability records with actual local tokenizer assets and declared deterministic test identities; do not copy production YAML or claim serving attestation. Record bytes/hashes/sizes/licenses and profiles before use. Text-only profiles omit document settings. Binary assets are provisioned explicitly before tests, never fetched on first use.
per_phase_run_binding_required: stable candidate and source export identity
Python/tool artifact identities and installed origins
exact phase lock and artifact manifest hashes
embedding/deployment and document-settings hashes where relevant
exact classified module/node/helper selectors and expected normal/optimized lanes
all owned paths and network/effect dispositions
opening/closing preserved-state checks and command evidence

preparation_only: selected public PyPI artifacts with recorded hashes
explicitly pinned public local-counter/OCR/layout assets from preserved evaluated manifests
network.tests: No external network/provider/model calls. Only explicitly owned local fixture-server connections for named offline MCP/integration cases are allowed; record endpoints and teardown. No connection to LM Studio or other model services.
network.configuration: Installer/tool isolated or no-config modes and private caches; no inherited proxy/credential/index fallback. Disable automatic model/hub downloads in tests. An unresolved channel refuses instead of falling back.

additional_preservation: Preserve earlier .friday_test runs, global model/package caches and all user documents/state. Changes are limited to selected feature-branch source/test/docs/lock paths after approval and this new private run. No production installation, reset, model switch or cleanup.
isolation_limit: Private roots and guarded/no-config execution are not an OS security sandbox. Distinguish prevention, detection and residual native-tool behavior; stop on an unexplained protected-state change.
provider_behavior: Deterministic dimension-correct provider responses, real local tokenizers/counters and actual disposable Chroma readback/reopen. These prove integration and guards, not embedding-model quality or serving parity.
worker_thresholds: Unchanged reviewed shared-contracts section4/RD-03: construct at I3-C1; real process/IPC/resource/cancel/timeout/drain proof I3-C4, including actual app and headless consumers.
permitted_after_approval: local counting and deterministic-provider integration tests
fresh independent implementation validation at approved slice/aggregate gates
excluded: production configurations/environments/stores and prior test run mutation
external model/provider calls or model load/unload
Finance live integration or credential reads
user-document ingestion or legacy placeholder cleanup
